comparator.name: Archaeology
comparator.sourceNotes: The selected English-language Archaeology trajectory closes 60+60+60; the Dutch trajectory is not stacked. Current placement keeps Philosophy of the Humanities in Year 2 and Lieux de mémoire in Year 3. The literacy test, ACASA orientation and recurring tutoring are mandatory zero-credit formation and do not increase the total. The announced UvA-VU joint degree begins in 2027-2028, so the current award identity, raw RIO provenance and permanent identifier remain unchanged.

routeSelection.basis: The normalized target merges current English Archaeology and Dutch Archeologie offerings. Their official curriculum pages show the same academic structure and compulsory sequence. The English trajectory is used as the representative pathway because the normalized display name is Archaeology and the English page provides the complete current component list; no content from the Dutch trajectory is added.

exception.reason: The corrected external curriculum is complete at 180 EC. The superseded UCR no-match judgment is preserved in remediation history for the separately excluded UCR reassessment.
